Headline: Muy mala estancia

Positive: 

Negative: No había agua caliente, no me pude duchar. No había calefacción y había mucho frío, casi me enfermo. Perdí 2 días de mis vacaciones y el anfitrión no me ayudó al comunicarle los problemas.  La televisión no funciona, tuvimos que comprar baterías nuevas y tampoco funcionó. Había mucho moho en un cabinete de la cocina. Pésima estancia. El anfitrión no nos devolvió el dinero pagado y tuvimos que cambiar a un hotel. No lo recomiendo para nada.

attributes.content:
Headline: 

Positive: Super séjour ! 
Je recommande fortement !

Negative:

Headline: We won’t be back

Positive: 

Negative: Check in not until 5pm and check out is 11am.  Overly complicated check in process which makes you use an external app, and at exactly 5 pm you’ll be given your access code for gate, another code to get in the building and then another code to get the keys.  Once inside, you’ll find a coffee machine as advertised, but no coffee!. There were 2 tea bags, probably left by previous guest as opposed to being left intentionally.  There was an ironing board in living room, but no iron, so again pointless feature.  For stay of 2 adults and 2 children for 2 nights, we were supplied with 1 x roll of toilet paper.  Location is 15 min walk into Senlis.  The apartment was clean but that’s pretty much only good thing about it.  Prior to departing your receive 3 emails starting the night before, reminding you that check out is 11am and you need to pay extra to extend it.  For the price, there are a lot of other places to stay in Senlis, we won’t be staying here again.
